title: Bang Bang Airfryer Chicken
instructions: Cut a criss-cross pattern into the chicken breast and season all over with the salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and cayenne pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, sriracha, and lemon juice until creamy. Rub the sauce onto the top of the chicken.
Air fry at 375°F for 15 minutes (times can vary by air fryer), until cooked through.
Serve with cilantro lime rice, sliced avocado, and green onions. Drizzle with extra sauce.

tips.title: Salmon swap
tips.text: This also works with salmon instead of chicken — same sauce, same air fryer method; check for doneness.

notes: Serve as a bang bang chicken bowl: cilantro lime rice, sliced avocado, and green onions, drizzled with extra sauce. From Instagram @tastewithnicki (via @eatinghealthyfeed). The submitted screenshot's food photo shows the raw prepped chicken, so the banner is an AI-generated stand-in and is flagged for replacement with a real photo.
